utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, the repair drive’s still rolling — folks are collecting donations and sorting out the biggest fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — let’s keep that clear time locked in, and I’ll send the details around so everyone can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m here now—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still on—if you can help, I just need a few open slots filled and I’ll send the locations over. Keep it simple and I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I’m here—what’s still left for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries—I can check what we’ve got left and put together a quick needs list. Just tell me what’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m ready to help—what’s the first thing you need me to handle for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — could you start by checking which locations still need supplies and note any repair priorities?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — it’s on Sunday at the community center, so that should give you some room around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, Sunday works for me — I can swing by after school pickup. Thanks for coordinating it at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Uli, are you still able to help with the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can help a little—just keep it low-key. If there’s a small task this weekend, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I can keep lending tools and help check what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Gus—let’s pick one fixed time and keep the list short so it stays manageable.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Happy to help — what’s the simplest task you want me to take for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Let’s set a clear time for the repair drive and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — if you can keep it to the plan and a few concrete needs, that’ll help me keep the repair drive simple and low-stress.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great—send me the locations when you have them, and I’ll keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still set for Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard folks are still gathering donations and sorting the repair priorities, so a clear time would help me pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Nell — that helps. If you can pass along the donation updates and the top repair priorities, I’ll turn it into a simple list for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check what’s running low first and make a quick list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — send the list when you’re ready, and I’ll keep track of the locations for the repair drive.
